an8.26:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Jīvakambavane.
an8.26:1.2: Atha kho Jīvako Komārabhacco yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Jīvako Komārabhacco Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.26:1.3: ‘kittāvatā nu kho bhante upāsako hotī' ti?
an8.26:1.4: Yato kho Jīvaka buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti:
an8.26:1.5: ettāvatā kho Jīvaka upāsako hotī ti. 2.
an8.26:2.1: ‘Kittāvatā pana bhante upāsako sīlavā hotī ti' ?
an8.26:2.2: Yato kho Jīvaka upāsako pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti . . . pe . . . surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti:
an8.26:2.3: ettāvatā kho Jīvaka upāsako sīlavā hotī ti. 3.
an8.26:3.1: ‘Kittāvatā pana bhante upāsako attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāyā' ti?
an8.26:3.2: Yato kho Jīvaka upāsako attanā saddhāsampanno hoti no paraṃ saddhāsampadāya samādapeti . . . pe . . .
an8.26:3.3: attanā attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti no paraṃ dhammānudhammapaṭipattiyā samādapeti:
an8.26:3.4: ettāvatā kho Jīvaka upāsako attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāyā ti. 4.
an8.26:4.1: ‘Kittāvatā pana bhante upāsako attahitāya ca paṭipanno hoti parahitāya cā' ti?
an8.26:4.2: Yato kho Jīvaka upāsako attanā ca saddhāsampanno hoti parañ ca saddhāsampadāya samādapeti,
an8.26:4.3: attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti parañ ca sīlasampadāya samādapeti,
an8.26:4.4: attanā ca cāgasampanno hoti parañ ca cāgasampadāya samādapeti,
an8.26:4.5: attanā ca bhikkhūnaṃ dassanakāmo hoti parañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ dassane samādapeti,
an8.26:4.6: attanā ca saddhammaṃ sotukāmo hoti parañ ca saddhammasavane samādapeti,
an8.26:4.7: attanā ca sutānaṃ dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti parañ ca dhammadhāraṇāya samādapeti,
an8.26:4.8: attanā ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthūpaparikkhī hoti parañ ca atthūpaparikkhāya samādapeti,
an8.26:4.9: attanā ca attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti parañ ca dhammānudhammapaṭipattiyā samādapeti:
an8.26:4.10: ettāvatā kho Jīvaka upāsako attahitāya ca paṭipanno hoti parahitāya cā ti. 1.
